job.job_description:
Roles and Responsibilities :

Design, develop, test, and deploy AI-powered solutions using computer vision, machine learning algorithms, and robotics engineering principles.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI models into existing systems and applications.
Develop data pipelines to collect, process, and analyze large datasets for training and testing AI models.
Troubleshoot issues related to AI model performance, data quality, and system integration.

Job Requirements :

4-10 years of experience in AI engineering or a related field (e.g., robotic engineer).
Strong proficiency in programming languages such as Python or C++.
Experience with computer vision techniques including image processing, object detection, tracking etc.
